summary: *_config modules compare lines text to the stored config, which uses long-form commands, so abbreviations like shut always report changed; use full commands such as shutdown with parents.
questions: Why does ios_config always report changed?
Can I use abbreviated commands in *_config modules?
How do I make network config tasks idempotent?

answer_card.title: Abbreviations cause changed=true
answer_card.answer_md:
The device stores config in long form, and `*_config` modules compare your `lines` text to it. `shut` never matches `shutdown`, so the task reports `changed=true` every run.

Use full commands:
```yaml
- cisco.ios.ios_config:
    lines:
      - shutdown
    parents: interface GigabitEthernet1/0/11
```
(`*_command` modules are fine with abbreviations.)
